card.title: Use the Proper Title
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My place card should say Chairperson, not simply Jo.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody will struggle with the extra word.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no room on the card.

mechanism: A insists that a place setting visibly name the office rather than only the familiar person.
confusable: Unlike correcting an unknown name, A must seek the added status sign even when recognition is already assured.
comparison: D57-b demands a larger surface for the title; D57-a demands an introduction for the assigned service.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
